key_points.point: Issue price 150.80 yuan/share; 4,044.6434 万股 (40,446,434 shares) issued, all new shares, no secondary sales

Clawback trigger: the preliminary online effective subscription multiple of ~8,288.82x exceeded 100x, so 10% of the post-strategic-placement offering (323.6000 万股) was clawed back from offline to online
After clawback: offline final 2,265.0148 万股 (~70%), online final 970.7000 万股 (~30%); final online winning rate 0.01809759%
All abandoned shares were absorbed by lead underwriter CITIC Securities: 8,734 shares / 1,317,087.20 yuan, ~0.03% of the post-strategic-placement offering; zero offline abandonment
Gross proceeds ≈ 6.099 billion yuan (150.80 × 40,446,434, derived); total issuance costs 18,217.31 万元
The 20.00% strategic placement includes the social security fund, industrial investors (DeepSeek, Tencent-affiliated Qishan) and the sponsor co-investment, with 12-36 month lockups

notes: Precision is the crux: writing the 0.01809759% winning rate as 1.8% or 0.018 (ratio confusion), swapping the 8,288.82x multiple with the 10% clawback ratio, or botching the 万股-to-share conversion (4,044.6434 万股 = 40,446,434 shares) all lose points. N10 is the only derived number (0.5% tolerance; ~6.099B yuan / 6,099,322,247.2 yuan both acceptable). Abandoned shares (8,734) and underwritten shares are the same fact seen twice, not two numbers. Evidence quotes remain in the original Chinese.
